scope: Play button only; no slider or toolbar changes.

geometry.model: C2 radial inverse-map splice; C3 at inner endpoint, not recovered surface curvature
geometry.material: Fixed pass04 coefficients and source sigma; no per-candidate nuisance refit

blur_reference.limits: Single-frame detail diagnostic. Source registration, video compression and material errors confound blur identification; no recovered Apple blur-stage claim.

icon_ordered_model.reason: Moving the unconstrained response over other dunes exposed pink reversals. Common strength and ordered exponents preserve R>=G>=B for warm RGB inputs. This is a constraint of this scene/control response, not a universal Apple material law.

icon_shared_model.formula: w=[w1,w2,w3,1]; cumulative=[0,cumsum(w)/sum(w)]; values=[floor+(1-floor)*cumulative,1]; knots=[threshold*[0,.3,.55,.8,1],1]; apply same monotone PCHIP to each RGB component.
icon_shared_model.notes: Five parameters; shared scalar function preserves component order and neutral grays for every RGB input. White plateau and C1 transitions. Still an empirical encoded-RGB response, not recovered Apple shading.

icon_models.notes: Encoded-RGB empirical responses of the refracted background; no positional gradient or copied interior colors. Same mask and feather. Two optimizer starts; block-withheld check on the same scene.

combined.additional_geometry_control: q4-w2-g1, same icon parameters and blur
